CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Simple Folders** adds folders to the Unraid Docker page.
Group related containers into a folder and fold it away behind a single row that still shows every member's icon; click any of those icons to get that container's own menu, or unfold the folder to see the full rows in start order.
A folder's icon opens its commands — start, stop, restart, pause, resume, check for updates, update, force update and open every WebUI — each running across the whole folder, one container at a time, honouring the folder's start order, its delay between starts, and reverse-order stop.
Folders can fill themselves from a name pattern or a Docker label, including containers created later. Folder start order drives Unraid's own autostart order rather than shadowing it, so containers come up at boot in the same order the folder uses. Editing or deleting a folder never stops, removes or recreates a container, and a "Classic view" switch restores the standard Unraid table at any time.
Requires Unraid 7.2 or newer. Support through the repository's Issues page.
Folder icons can be searched and downloaded from [Dashboard Icons](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons) (Apache-2.0) and [selfh.st/icons](https://selfh.st/icons/) (CC BY 4.0); no artwork is bundled with the plugin.
